sentences.en: You were like on your way out the door.
sentences.zh: 你就像是已经一只脚踏出门外了。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样。

sentences.en: I was actually like almost all the way packed, like truly ready to move.
sentences.zh: 我其实行李都快打包好了，是真的准备好要搬走了。

sentences.en: And I was dating an Australian guy who had just moved to Australia, and I was meant to follow him like a couple weeks later.
sentences.zh: 当时我在和一个澳大利亚男生约会，他刚搬回澳大利亚，我本打算几周后就跟过去。

sentences.en: Lindsay couldn't leave, and she had to scramble to find a place to stay.
sentences.zh: 琳赛没能走成，她不得不匆忙找个地方住下。

sentences.en: Eventually, she got an apartment on the south side of Dublin.
sentences.zh: 最终，她在都柏林南区租到了一套公寓。

sentences.en: It was actually this great place, a one-bedroom and a really pretty row house.
sentences.zh: 那其实是个很棒的地方，一室一厅，是一栋非常漂亮的联排别墅。

sentences.en: It looks like it was pulled out of 101 Dalmatians or something.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是从《101忠狗》里搬出来的一样。

sentences.en: The place was cozy.
sentences.zh: 那个地方很温馨。

sentences.en: It had these pretty bay windows that looked out onto the street, and a sunny little breakfast nook in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 它有漂亮的凸窗可以俯瞰街道，厨房里还有一个阳光明媚的小早餐角。

sentences.en: Not that things were going super great for Lindsay otherwise.
sentences.zh: 并不是说琳赛当时的生活一切都很顺利。

sentences.en: She and that Australian guy broke up.
sentences.zh: 她和那个澳大利亚男生分手了。

sentences.en: Her move, her new job, new life, all that got called off in slow motion.
sentences.zh: 她的搬迁、新工作、新生活，所有这一切都在缓慢地化为泡影。

sentences.en: And Lindsay, she was alone in lockdown.
sentences.zh: 而琳赛，她独自一人被困在封锁中。

sentences.en: She says this was actually one of the more depressing times she remembers.
sentences.zh: 她说这是她记忆中最压抑的时期之一。

sentences.en: And it was in the middle of all of that that she started to hear music three or four times a day.
sentences.zh: 正是在那段日子里，她开始每天三四次听到音乐声。

sentences.en: I would notice when I was like, you know,
sentences.zh: 我会注意到，当我，你知道，

sentences.en: I'd be doing the dishes, or I'd be doing something so mundane, and then, you know, it would, it would, like, happen.
sentences.zh: 我会在洗碗，或者做些琐事的时候，然后，你知道，它就会，它就会，就这样发生了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The music was coming from nearby.
sentences.zh: 音乐是从附近传来的。

sentences.en: It was a saxophone.
sentences.zh: 那是萨克斯风的声音。

sentences.en: Somebody practicing.
sentences.zh: 有人在练习。

sentences.en: Pretty clearly a beginner.
sentences.zh: 很明显是个初学者。

sentences.en: But the most notable part of it was the song.
sentences.zh: 但最引人注目的是那首歌。

sentences.en: It was the same one.
sentences.zh: 总是同一首。

sentences.en: Every day.
sentences.zh: 每一天。

sentences.en: Again, and again, and again.
sentences.zh: 一遍，又一遍，再一遍。

sentences.en: It was the Pink Panther theme song.
sentences.zh: 那是《粉红豹》的主题曲。

sentences.en: What you're hearing is actually the sound of a video montage Lindsay put together.
sentences.zh: 你现在听到的其实是琳赛剪辑的一段视频蒙太奇的声音。

sentences.en: And the funny of this, it was not lost on her.
sentences.zh: 而这其中的荒诞之处，她自己也深有体会。

sentences.en: In the video, you notice the range of time stamps.
sentences.zh: 在视频里，你会注意到时间戳的跨度。

sentences.en: Morning, afternoon, 10.30 at night.
sentences.zh: 早上、下午，晚上10点半。

sentences.en: The Pink Panther theme always in the background.
sentences.zh: 背景里总是响着《粉红豹》的主题曲。

sentences.en: You'll hear it as Lindsay eats at her kitchen table or leans against a doorframe in her living room holding back a smile as she lays on a yoga mat or walks through her hall.
sentences.zh: 你会听到琳赛在餐桌旁吃饭时，或者靠在客厅门框上忍住笑意时，又或是躺在瑜伽垫上、走在走廊里时，背景里都响着这首歌。

sentences.en: When he picked up the horn and you first heard the notes come out, you were like, oh, I'm in for how long?
sentences.zh: 当他拿起萨克斯，你第一次听到声音传出来的时候，你当时想的是，噢，我要忍受多久？

sentences.en: I'd say 45 minutes or an hour.
sentences.zh: 我会说45分钟到一个小时。

sentences.en: 45 minutes to an hour?
sentences.zh: 45分钟到一个小时？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Or maybe, oh God, now I feel like, is that crazy?
sentences.zh: 或者也许，天哪，现在我觉得，这很疯狂吗？

sentences.en: Maybe 20 to 30 minutes?
sentences.zh: 也许20到30分钟？

sentences.en: I mean, maybe it was 20 to 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我是说，也许是20到30分钟吧。

sentences.en: It felt to me like it was never ending.
sentences.zh: 对我来说感觉就像没完没了。

sentences.en: It felt to me by the end that I was just, it was all day, all night.
sentences.zh: 到最后我觉得，这简直是全天候不间断的。

sentences.en: So it like became like a staple of your existence.
sentences.zh: 所以它成了你生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like, and it was to the point where like,
sentences.zh: 就像，到了那种程度，比如，

sentences.en: like I was trying to work during the day.
sentences.zh: 我白天试着工作。

sentences.en: I was trying to get things done.
sentences.zh: 我试着把事情做完。

sentences.en: And then, you know, I'd be in a meeting and all my coworkers could hear.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我在开会，我所有的同事都能听到。

sentences.en: Lindsay was now working remotely from this Dublin apartment.
sentences.zh: 琳赛当时正在这间都柏林公寓里远程办公。

sentences.en: And all the pink panthering became a running joke for the people that you worked with.
sentences.zh: 所有的“粉红豹”演奏成了你同事间的一个梗。

sentences.en: It was so audible that Lindsay found herself constantly having to mute during video meetings.
sentences.zh: 声音大到琳赛发现自己在视频会议期间不得不频繁静音。

sentences.en: Because mics on phones vary so much.
sentences.zh: 因为手机麦克风的收音效果差异很大。

sentences.en: Like, I couldn't totally grasp how loud it was in person.
sentences.zh: 我无法完全体会现场听起来有多大声。

sentences.en: Like, how loud was it?
sentences.zh: 到底有多大声？

sentences.en: Oh, I mean, it sounded like it was in my house.
sentences.zh: 噢，我是说，听起来就像在我屋里一样。

sentences.en: So when I posted this on Twitter, people were like, you know, I got all kinds of responses, but people were, you know, wondering if I, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以当我在推特上发布这个视频时，人们，你知道，我收到了各种各样的回复，但人们，你知道，在想我是否，你知道，

sentences.en: if I was, you know, playing a recording of it in my house.
sentences.zh: 是否在屋里播放录音。

sentences.en: But it was so loud that it did sound like it was coming from inside the house.
sentences.zh: 但声音确实大到听起来像是从屋里传出来的。

sentences.en: And I don't know if he knew how loud it was.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是否知道声音有多大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And I don't think he did.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他不知道。

sentences.en: Lindsay says this went on for weeks and weeks, several times every day.
sentences.zh: 琳赛说这种情况持续了好几周，每天好几次。

sentences.en: Just to point out, most days, this was actually her only real-life human contact.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，大多数日子里，这其实是她唯一真实的社交接触。

sentences.en: The saxophone coming through the walls.
sentences.zh: 穿墙而来的萨克斯声。

sentences.en: The video montage that Lindsay made of all this, she eventually tweeted it and accumulated 5.4 million views.
sentences.zh: 琳赛制作的这段视频蒙太奇，最终在推特上获得了540万次观看。

sentences.en: Just for scale, Miles Davis' Kind of Blue has sold 5 million copies.
sentences.zh: 作为对比，迈尔斯·戴维斯的《Kind of Blue》销量是500万张。

sentences.en: The internet responded, like the internet, some of the 4.7,000 comments.
sentences.zh: 互联网的反应就像互联网一贯的那样，那4700条评论里有些是这样的：

sentences.en: Interesting how they got further from nailing it the longer they practiced.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他们练习得越久，离弹对就越远。

sentences.en: Your neighbor's horrible playing should be a crime.
sentences.zh: 你邻居那糟糕的演奏简直是犯罪。

sentences.en: My condolences.
sentences.zh: 向你表示哀悼。

sentences.en: You'd think that the performance would at least improve over time.
sentences.zh: 你本以为演奏水平至少会随着时间提高。

sentences.en: Someone chimes in.
sentences.zh: 有人插话道。

sentences.en: Sounds like he's still shite, too.
sentences.zh: 听起来他还是很烂。

sentences.en: The insurance company, Geico, responded.
sentences.zh: 保险公司Geico也回复了。

sentences.en: We feel your pain.
sentences.zh: 我们感同身受。

sentences.en: For a long time, Lindsay didn't know who the Pink Panther was.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，琳赛都不知道“粉红豹”是谁。

sentences.en: So when she'd see people in the halls of her building, it was a little like,
sentences.zh: 所以当她在楼道里看到人时，会有点像，

sentences.en: Is that them?
sentences.zh: 是他们吗？

sentences.en: Wait, is that them?
sentences.zh: 等等，是他们吗？

sentences.en: Though eventually, her suspicion snagged on this one guy.
sentences.zh: 不过最终，她的怀疑锁定在了一个人身上。

sentences.en: I would see this guy outside drinking.
sentences.zh: 我经常看到这个人在外面喝酒。

sentences.en: He would always do this thing where he would walk outside to drink his coffee, kind of like in his pajamas.
sentences.zh: 他总是做那种事，穿着睡衣出来喝咖啡。

sentences.en: And I had a feeling it was him, but I wasn't sure.
sentences.zh: 我有预感是他，但我不确定。

sentences.en: For some reason, I feel like drinking coffee outside in your pajamas is kind of saxophone behavior.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，我觉得穿着睡衣在外面喝咖啡有一种“萨克斯风气质”。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: He had a vibe.
sentences.zh: 他很有那种范儿。

sentences.en: It was a saxophone vibe.
sentences.zh: 那是萨克斯风的范儿。

sentences.en: He had a saxophone vibe, for sure.
sentences.zh: 他绝对有萨克斯风的范儿。

sentences.en: So, come with me, if you will, to the other side of Lindsay's wall, to the other end of the saxophone rainbow, where there was a young man named Rajat.
sentences.zh: 那么，如果你愿意，请跟我一起穿过琳赛的墙，来到萨克斯风彩虹的另一端，那里住着一个叫拉贾特的年轻人。

sentences.en: At the time, he was 23, like Lindsay, who was living and working in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 当时他23岁，和琳赛一样，在爱尔兰生活和工作。

sentences.en: As far as Rajat knew, his only audience was inside his apartment, at this window where he would practice.
sentences.zh: 据拉贾特所知，他唯一的听众就在他公寓里，在他练习的窗边。

sentences.en: I had a large window, and on the windowsill, I had three plants.
sentences.zh: 我有一个大窗户，窗台上放着三盆植物。

sentences.en: A basil plant.
sentences.zh: 一盆罗勒。

sentences.en: I just randomly had a potato that was going off, and I put it into a pot, and it started to grow.
sentences.zh: 我随手拿了一个快坏掉的土豆，把它种进盆里，它竟然开始发芽了。

sentences.en: So that was my potted potato plant.
sentences.zh: 所以那是我的盆栽土豆。

sentences.en: And there was a coriander plant as well.
sentences.zh: 还有一盆香菜。

sentences.en: So I would play to them.
sentences.zh: 所以我就是对着它们演奏。

sentences.en: Like, you know, that's my audience every day.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，那是我的日常听众。

sentences.en: And, hey, I still believe that that potted potato plant grew.
sentences.zh: 而且，嘿，我至今相信那盆土豆长得很好。

sentences.en: It took off.
sentences.zh: 它长势喜人。

sentences.en: So I think I had something to do with it.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这跟我有关系。

sentences.en: No joke.
sentences.zh: 没开玩笑。

sentences.en: It was like, it was super tall.
sentences.zh: 它长得超级高。

sentences.en: Rajat told me, for the record, he had no idea people could hear him like this.
sentences.zh: 拉贾特告诉我，郑重声明，他根本不知道别人能听到他这样演奏。

sentences.en: He said, some people in the building had remarked on how he was learning the saxophone.
sentences.zh: 他说，楼里有些人曾提到他在学萨克斯。

sentences.en: But he just figured, this building's old, it's gotta have thick walls.
sentences.zh: 但他只是觉得，这栋楼很老，墙壁肯定很厚。

sentences.en: Maybe they hear me, like, faintly, off in the distance.
sentences.zh: 也许他们能听到，就像，隐隐约约，从远处传来。

sentences.en: Lindsay did eventually come over at some point.
sentences.zh: 琳赛最终还是在某个时候找上门了。

sentences.en: She introduced herself, and she asked him to stop because she had a migraine.
sentences.zh: 她做了自我介绍，并请他停止练习，因为她偏头痛。

sentences.en: Rajat says Lindsay was super nice.
sentences.zh: 拉贾特说琳赛人超级好。

sentences.en: Lindsay says Rajat was, like, genuinely surprised and very sweet.
sentences.zh: 琳赛说拉贾特当时看起来真的很惊讶，而且非常贴心。

sentences.en: For my fellow rom-com fans, I will note that they are not engaged.
sentences.zh: 对于和我一样的浪漫喜剧迷，我要说明一下，他们并没有订婚。

sentences.en: But the point is, Rajat actually had no idea how loud his saxophone playing was for her.
sentences.zh: 但重点是，拉贾特确实不知道他的萨克斯演奏对她来说有多吵。

sentences.en: Until he saw Lindsay's video later.
sentences.zh: 直到后来他看到了琳赛的视频。

sentences.en: When I saw the video, I was like, wow, that's really loud in her house.
sentences.zh: 当我看到视频时，我想，哇，在她屋里声音真的好大。

sentences.en: I did not think it was that loud in her house.
sentences.zh: 我没想到在她屋里声音有那么大。

sentences.en: Because that was, like, almost how loud it was for me, like, when I was playing.
sentences.zh: 因为那几乎和我演奏时听到的音量差不多。

sentences.en: And so when I heard it, for the first time, from her perspective, I was like, yeah, I would have had a problem as well if I was there.
sentences.zh: 所以当我第一次从她的角度听到时，我想，是的，如果我在那儿，我也会有意见的。

sentences.en: Rajat felt like, oh, shoot, I did not know I was bothering anyone.
sentences.zh: 拉贾特觉得，噢，糟了，我不知道我打扰到别人了。

sentences.en: He asked Lindsay what would be a good time to play, and he started practicing during his lunch hour.
sentences.zh: 他问琳赛什么时候练习比较合适，于是他开始在午休时间练习。

sentences.en: Though an hour was barely enough, he told me.
sentences.zh: 尽管他告诉我，一个小时根本不够。

sentences.en: Because what was unfolding on Rajat's side of the building was a love story.
sentences.zh: 因为在拉贾特那一侧的楼里，正在上演一段爱情故事。

sentences.en: A budding romance with the alto saxophone that had started just a few months before this.
sentences.zh: 一段与中音萨克斯风的萌芽之恋，始于几个月前。

sentences.en: Turns out, before COVID hit, in December, Rajat was visiting India.
sentences.zh: 原来，在新冠疫情爆发前的十二月，拉贾特正在印度探亲。

sentences.en: He's from Bangalore.
sentences.zh: 他来自班加罗尔。

sentences.en: And he was visiting old friends.
sentences.zh: 他当时在拜访老朋友。

sentences.en: One of these friends lives on a farm.
sentences.zh: 其中一个朋友住在农场里。

sentences.en: Rajat says this place is just beautiful.
sentences.zh: 拉贾特说那个地方美极了。

sentences.en: So all these friends, they're there, and they're hanging out.
sentences.zh: 所有的朋友都在那儿聚会。

sentences.en: And one of them picked up a saxophone, right?
sentences.zh: 其中一个人拿起了一把萨克斯，对吧？

sentences.en: And it was alto sax, this nice, cute little guy.
sentences.zh: 那是把中音萨克斯，一个可爱的小家伙。

sentences.en: And we were all just working, and he has a little wood shop then we were working.
sentences.zh: 我们当时都在干活，他有个小木工坊，我们在那儿忙活。

sentences.en: And from the background, I hear someone playing the beginning riff of Ain't No Sunshine.
sentences.zh: 背景里，我听到有人在吹《Ain't No Sunshine》的开头旋律。

sentences.en: And I look out, and it's my friend.
sentences.zh: 我往外一看，是我朋友。

sentences.en: He's wearing slippers, flip-flops in shorts, sweating because the sun's out, even in December in India.
sentences.zh: 他穿着拖鞋、短裤，因为即使在十二月的印度，阳光也很充足，他满头大汗。

sentences.en: And he's just like, it's kind of like the Pied Piper.
sentences.zh: 他就像是吹笛人一样。

sentences.en: He's like a few dogs walking behind him, and he's playing the tune.
sentences.zh: 几只狗跟在他身后，他吹着那首曲子。

sentences.en: And I looked at him, and I was like, yo, that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 我看着他，我说，哟，那太棒了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Rajat's friend was like, hey, you should try it.
sentences.zh: 拉贾特的朋友说，嘿，你应该试试。

sentences.en: He was like, okay.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧。

sentences.en: Almost immediately, he was able to get a sound out of the horn.
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻，他就吹出了声音。

sentences.en: So his friend taught him the first line from Ain't No Sunshine.
sentences.zh: 于是他朋友教了他《Ain't No Sunshine》的第一句。

sentences.en: And Rajat was off and running.
sentences.zh: 拉贾特就这样开始了。

sentences.en: And I was just off by myself, playing out into the fields.
sentences.zh: 我独自一人，对着田野吹奏。

sentences.en: Like, literally, I would say for like a good, like, if not 45, at least 30, you know, 30 minutes or so.
sentences.zh: 真的，我会说大概吹了，如果不到45分钟，至少也有30分钟左右。

sentences.en: I was just constantly drilling and drilling and drilling and drilling and drilling it.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是不停地练习，练习，练习，练习，一直在练。

sentences.en: And that was a moment.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个特别的时刻。

sentences.en: Like, I was getting into a flow.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我进入了一种心流状态。

sentences.en: And I think also with the saxophone, because you keep blowing so much, there's some degree of like, and then you like, and then you blow again.
sentences.zh: 我想这也和萨克斯有关，因为你得不停地吹气，所以会有某种程度的……然后你又接着吹。

sentences.en: So there's a high degree of like, you know, when you like rapid breathe, when you meditate, there's some degree of like, you're getting kind of like, whoa, what's happening?
sentences.zh: 所以会有很高程度的，你知道，当你像冥想时那样快速呼吸，会有某种程度的，你会觉得，哇，这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Like, and so I was getting into this flow state with that, and I was like, wow, this is so good.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我进入了那种心流状态，我当时觉得，哇，这太棒了。

sentences.en: Like, getting that sound to come out of the saxophone right away, did you feel a little bit like, oh, like, I'm, I'm kind of a natural.
sentences.zh: 比如，萨克斯吹出的声音立刻就对了，你有没有觉得，哦，我好像是个天才。

sentences.en: Like, that, like, yeah, yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 就像是，对，确实是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对，确实如此。

sentences.en: When he got back to Ireland, he researched carefully, and he bought a saxophone, an alto.
sentences.zh: 他回到爱尔兰后，仔细研究了一番，然后买了一把萨克斯，中音萨克斯。

sentences.en: And then he set about learning to play it.
sentences.zh: 接着他就开始着手学习演奏。

sentences.en: He made this little notebook for himself.
sentences.zh: 他给自己做了一个小笔记本。

sentences.en: On the first page, all caps, he wrote, consistency is key, meaning practice every day, a little bit, or a lot.
sentences.zh: 在第一页，他用大写字母写着：坚持是关键，意思是每天都要练习，哪怕一点点，或者多练一点。

sentences.en: On the second page, he made a list of songs that he wanted to learn, including, of course, the Pink Panther.
sentences.zh: 在第二页，他列了一份想学的歌曲清单，当然，其中就包括《粉红豹》。

sentences.en: Rajat told me this was the song he maybe most identified with the saxophone.
sentences.zh: Rajat告诉我，这首歌可能是他觉得和萨克斯联系最紧密的。

sentences.en: And so he found a video tutorial of it online, where a guy walks through the song phrase by phrase.
sentences.zh: 于是他在网上找了一个教学视频，视频里的人逐句演示这首歌。

sentences.en: And so I would have drilled that video like 80 plus times, like, just like, like, you know, just again, and again, and again, and again, and just keep going, keep going,
sentences.zh: 我大概把那个视频练习了80多遍，就是，你知道，一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍，一直练，一直练，

sentences.en: keep going.
sentences.zh: 一直练。

sentences.en: You're like, I'm going to get this into my muscle memory.
sentences.zh: 你会想，我要把这个练进肌肉记忆里。

sentences.en: Like, yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: And because it was something I really wanted to get good, because it sounded so cool, like the final product at the end of that video, that I was like, I need to get this.
sentences.zh: 因为这是我真心想学好的东西，因为它听起来太酷了，视频结尾的成品听起来太棒了，所以我当时就想，我一定要学会这个。

sentences.en: Um, and I was not going to move on to anything else till I got this done.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在学会之前，我是不会去学别的曲子的。

sentences.en: So at one point in time, it was not in heavy rotation.
sentences.zh: 所以有一段时间，它并不是在轮换播放。

sentences.en: It was the rotation, you know.
sentences.zh: 它就是唯一的播放内容，你懂的。

sentences.en: Later, I don't know what you mean.
sentences.zh: 后来，我不知道你是什么意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I was not getting tired of it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但我并没有感到厌倦。

sentences.en: Like, it was, it was entertaining.
sentences.zh: 它，它很有趣。

sentences.en: And it was so nice to see because, like, at the end of it as well, there's this beautiful riff that, oh, that's so cool.
sentences.zh: 而且看到最后的效果真的很棒，因为结尾有一段非常美妙的即兴乐句，哦，那太酷了。

sentences.en: Like, it's so funky when you get it, right?
sentences.zh: 当你学会的时候，那种感觉真的很带感，对吧？

sentences.en: So, like, it would give me glimpses.
sentences.zh: 所以，它会让我看到一点希望。

sentences.en: Like, I do the first three phrases horribly, but I'd, like, I'd say, okay, play to the end.
sentences.zh: 比如，我前三句吹得一塌糊涂，但我会说，好吧，接着吹到最后。

sentences.en: And just the one time, one time, if I get the nice little riff properly, I'd get like, oh, this is going so well.
sentences.zh: 只要有那么一次，哪怕只有一次，如果我能把那段美妙的乐句吹好，我就会觉得，哦，这进展得太顺利了。

sentences.en: The thing I love about this situation is just how different the same song, played day in and day out for months,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个情况的一点是，同一首歌，在两个相邻的公寓里，由两个各自处于自己小世界里的人，日复一日地练习了几个月，

sentences.en: could feel in these two neighboring apartments by two people in their own little bubbles, like some kind of musical Rorschach teSt.
sentences.zh: 听起来竟然如此不同，就像某种音乐版的罗夏墨迹测试。

sentences.en: Like, for Lindsay, whether it was irritating or funny, it was an artifact of her confinement.
sentences.zh: 对于Lindsay来说，无论它是令人烦躁还是好笑，这都是她被禁足的产物。

sentences.en: But for Rajat, it was the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 但对Rajat来说，恰恰相反。

sentences.en: It was an escape.
sentences.zh: 这是一种逃避。

sentences.en: Yeah, because there's only so much Netflix you can do until you start feeling sick of doing that, you know?
sentences.zh: 是啊，因为Netflix看多了也会腻，你懂的，到最后你会觉得恶心。

sentences.en: And, yeah, so this was genuinely bright.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的是一道亮光。

sentences.en: Like, I was, I got up.
sentences.zh: 我当时，我起床后。

sentences.en: I was like, oh, I'm going to get to practice saxophone today.
sentences.zh: 我会想，哦，今天又能练萨克斯了。

sentences.en: Like, that got me through, you know?
sentences.zh: 这支撑着我度过那段日子，你懂的。

sentences.en: Looking back on this little chapter, for Lindsay's part, she told me, the main consequence of all this has been that months after leaving that apartment,
sentences.zh: 回首这段小插曲，对于Lindsay来说，她告诉我，这一切的主要后果就是，在离开那个公寓几个月后，

sentences.en: moving back to the United States, she's still hearing the Pink Panther theme all the time.
sentences.zh: 搬回美国后，她还是会一直听到《粉红豹》的主题曲。

sentences.en: It's just coming through the walls of her memory now, like a phantom limb, a pink phantom limb.
sentences.zh: 它现在就像幻肢一样，穿过她记忆的墙壁，一个粉红色的幻肢。

sentences.en: All of this has also stuck with Rajat.
sentences.zh: 这一切也一直留在Rajat心中。

sentences.en: So, believe it or not, but this five million view thing has scarred me to a certain extent.
sentences.zh: 所以，信不信由你，但这五百万次播放的事情在某种程度上给我留下了心理阴影。

sentences.en: Because, honestly, because I've now moved to Italy, right?
sentences.zh: 因为，老实说，因为我现在搬到了意大利，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm staying here, and I live in, like, these apartments where you share a courtyard.
sentences.zh: 我住在这里，我住的公寓是那种共享庭院的。

sentences.en: So, I have a balcony right here, and it opens out in this beautiful courtyard.
sentences.zh: 所以我这里有个阳台，正对着这个美丽的庭院。

sentences.en: You can see the sky, birds on top, lovely.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到天空，鸟儿在上面，很可爱。

sentences.en: But there is everybody around here, and it echoes.
sentences.zh: 但周围到处都是人，而且有回声。

sentences.en: So, I cannot play the saxophone here, because, at least in Dublin, if someone had an issue, I could speak to them and try to diffuse the situation.
sentences.zh: 所以我不能在这里吹萨克斯，因为在都柏林，如果有人有意见，我还可以和他们沟通，试图化解矛盾。

sentences.en: I cannot do that in Italian.
sentences.zh: 我没法用意大利语做这件事。

sentences.en: So, I can't.
sentences.zh: 所以我不能。

sentences.en: I can't.
sentences.zh: 我不能。

sentences.en: So, I actually found a spot in, you know, the storage rooms are super, like, dank.
sentences.zh: 所以我其实找了个地方，你知道，储藏室非常，非常阴暗。

sentences.en: Like, in the cellar, everything is musty, where they keep the suitcases.
sentences.zh: 就像地窖里，到处都是霉味，那是他们放行李箱的地方。

sentences.en: I managed to go there once and clear out some space, and I was like, this will be my saxophone room.
sentences.zh: 我设法去过那里一次，清理出了一些空间，我当时想，这就是我的萨克斯室了。

sentences.en: Rajat says, though, it's just so out of the way, he hasn't done it.
sentences.zh: 不过Rajat说，那里太偏僻了，他还没去过。

sentences.en: But, for Rajat, locked down in Dublin, he'd really been in this bubble, where, true or not, he was so convinced no one could hear him.
sentences.zh: 但对于在都柏林封锁期间的Rajat来说，他确实一直处于这种气泡中，无论真假，他都深信没人能听到他吹奏。

sentences.en: It was like he got to spend swaths of his day singing in the shower, dancing like no one was watching,
sentences.zh: 就像他可以整天在淋浴时唱歌，像没人看着一样跳舞，

sentences.en: loving the Pink Panther theme like he'd never been hurt, if you know what I mean.
sentences.zh: 像从未受过伤一样热爱《粉红豹》主题曲，你懂我的意思吗。

sentences.en: That became his every day.
sentences.zh: 那成了他的日常。

sentences.en: And since then, well, he's been a little unsure how to get back to that spot where he can play and feel quite so free.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，嗯，他有点不确定该如何回到那个可以自由自在吹奏的地方。

sentences.en: He's been chasing that feeling.
sentences.zh: 他一直在追寻那种感觉。

sentences.en: Aren't we all?
sentences.zh: 我们不都是这样吗？

sentences.en: Ben Calhoun is one of the producers of our show.
sentences.zh: Ben Calhoun是我们节目的制片人之一。

sentences.en: Act two, so nice to hear your voice.
sentences.zh: 第二幕，很高兴听到你的声音。

sentences.en: And I turned to somebody who had one daily routine that changed to a different daily routine.
sentences.zh: 我转向了一个日常作息发生改变的人。

sentences.en: And I don't want to get ahead of the story too much, but just to say what a vast effect it had on her.
sentences.zh: 我不想太快剧透，但只想说这对她产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: And how quickly those effects kicked in.
sentences.zh: 而且这些影响生效得非常快。

sentences.en: The person with the daily routine in the story is Dee Brown.
sentences.zh: 故事中那个有日常作息的人是Dee Brown。

sentences.en: She moved into long-term care five years ago.
sentences.zh: 她五年前搬进了长期护理机构。

sentences.en: And for four years, somebody would visit her every day.
sentences.zh: 在四年里，每天都有人去看望她。

sentences.en: Family or her best friend would come nearly every day.
sentences.zh: 家人或她最好的朋友几乎每天都会来。

sentences.en: They'd go out to eat, go on long drives into the mountains.
sentences.zh: 他们会出去吃饭，开车去山里兜风。

sentences.en: Then COVID hit.
sentences.zh: 然后新冠疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: And the facilities she was in, following national guidelines, didn't allow anybody to have any visitors.
sentences.zh: 她所在的机构遵循国家指导方针，不允许任何人探访。

sentences.en: Communal dining and group activities were also canceled.
sentences.zh: 公共用餐和集体活动也被取消了。

sentences.en: So Dee's family invented a new routine.
sentences.zh: 于是Dee的家人发明了一种新的日常。

sentences.en: Daily phone calls.
sentences.zh: 每天通电话。

sentences.en: Basically, they made a schedule for everybody in the family to phone.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们为家里的每个人制定了一个打电话的时间表。

sentences.en: And that way, Dee would get calls every single day.
sentences.zh: 这样，Dee每天都能接到电话。

sentences.en: They would chat.
sentences.zh: 他们会聊天。

sentences.en: They would socialize.
sentences.zh: 他们会社交。

sentences.en: They'd try to keep her spirits up.
sentences.zh: 他们会努力让她保持精神振奋。

sentences.en: Try to keep her from getting bored.
sentences.zh: 尽量不让她感到无聊。

sentences.en: Dee's granddaughter, Celia Brown, was one of the callers.
sentences.zh: Dee的孙女Celia Brown是打电话的人之一。

sentences.en: Phoning once a week or so.
sentences.zh: 大约每周打一次电话。

sentences.en: And she put together this story.
sentences.zh: 她整理了这个故事。

sentences.en: When my family started this, we figured, naively, we'd do this for a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 当我家人开始这样做时，我们天真地以为，我们只会做几周。

sentences.en: Maybe a month.
sentences.zh: 也许一个月。

sentences.en: Until things got back to normal.
sentences.zh: 直到一切恢复正常。

sentences.en: And the calls were fun.
sentences.zh: 而且通话很有趣。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Dee?
sentences.zh: Dee？

sentences.en: My first call, March 27th.
sentences.zh: 我第一次通话是在3月27日。

sentences.en: We were still getting used to the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们还在适应电话沟通。

sentences.en: Dee, I think you put me on hold.
sentences.zh: Dee，我想你把我设为保留通话了。

sentences.en: But Dee was pretty happy.
sentences.zh: 但Dee挺开心的。

sentences.en: She'd start most calls by telling me about how nice her apartment was.
sentences.zh: 她大多数通话开始时都会告诉我她的公寓有多好。

sentences.en: She took her calls from her favorite lounge chair.
sentences.zh: 她是在她最喜欢的躺椅上接电话的。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Oh, that was weird.
sentences.zh: 哦，那真奇怪。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: Yeah, what's up?
sentences.zh: 是啊，怎么了？

sentences.en: Dee loved to say the unexpected thing.
sentences.zh: Dee喜欢说些出人意料的话。

sentences.en: Make fun of herself if it meant making other people laugh.
sentences.zh: 如果能让别人笑，她不介意自嘲。

sentences.en: Oh, I have a real problem right now.
sentences.zh: 哦，我现在有个大麻烦。

sentences.en: I got some, like, underwear, the kind that stretches.
sentences.zh: 我买了一些内衣，那种有弹性的。

sentences.en: Only it's too tight.
sentences.zh: 结果太紧了。

sentences.en: And I sit down and they go, uh, my stomach goes, uh, those are big problems, right?
sentences.zh: 我一坐下来，它们就，呃，我的肚子就，呃，这些都是大问题，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, you juSt...
sentences.zh: 你知道，你只是……

sentences.en: Yeah, I have that problem, too.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我也有这个问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, you just think of me as you're trying to pull your underwear down so it's a little more...
sentences.zh: 是啊，好吧，当你试图把内裤往下拉，让它舒服点的时候，就想想我吧……

sentences.en: It makes you feel very graceful.
sentences.zh: 这会让你感觉非常优雅。

sentences.en: Growing up, Dee wasn't what I thought of as a typical grandma.
sentences.zh: 在我成长过程中，Dee并不是我心目中那种典型的祖母。

sentences.en: For one thing, we called her Dee, not grandma.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们叫她Dee，而不是祖母。

sentences.en: She also dressed like an old Colorado hippie.
sentences.zh: 她穿得像个老派的科罗拉多嬉皮士。

sentences.en: Tons of turquoise jewelry and tie-dye.
sentences.zh: 戴着大量的绿松石首饰，穿着扎染衣服。

sentences.en: She always smelled like coffee, which she drank all day, even at midnight.
sentences.zh: 她身上总有咖啡味，她整天都在喝咖啡，甚至在午夜也是。

sentences.en: She never did the normal grandma stuff with my sister and me, like take us out for ice cream or whatever.
sentences.zh: 她从不做那种普通祖母会和我姐姐及我做的事，比如带我们出去吃冰淇淋什么的。

sentences.en: Dee was a talker, so that's what we'd do.
sentences.zh: Dee是个话痨，所以我们经常做的事就是聊天。

sentences.en: Sit in the backyard and talk for hours.
sentences.zh: 坐在后院聊上几个小时。

sentences.en: Didn't matter how old you were.
sentences.zh: 无论你多大年纪都一样。

sentences.en: And she was funny, though my dad said she'd sometimes disguise something as a joke, just to get what she wanted.
sentences.zh: 她很风趣，虽然我爸爸说她有时会把某种意图伪装成玩笑，只是为了得到她想要的。

sentences.en: In her 40s, after raising three kids and getting a divorce, she ended up in AA.
sentences.zh: 40多岁时，在抚养了三个孩子并离婚后，她进了戒酒互助会。

sentences.en: It became a huge part of her life.
sentences.zh: 那成了她生命中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: So much so, she ended up sponsoring over 100 people.
sentences.zh: 以至于她最终成为了100多人的担保人。

sentences.en: She'd still go to meetings a few times a week.
sentences.zh: 她每周还会去参加几次会议。

sentences.en: Now, of course, all that was gone.
sentences.zh: 现在，当然，这一切都没了。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's been kind of a boring day because I haven't been able to go to the store and call my friend who has my car.
sentences.zh: 是啊，今天有点无聊，因为我没法去商店，也没法给那个有我车的朋友打电话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Can you walk in the hallway?
sentences.zh: 你能在走廊里走走吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I've walked in the hallways, and everybody else is walking in the hallway, too, you know, because I'm just trying to get a little exercise.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我在走廊里走过，其他人也在走廊里走，你知道，因为我只是想稍微锻炼一下。

sentences.en: But, you know, this will pass, and we'll be okay.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这一切都会过去的，我们会没事的。

sentences.en: It's not going to kill me sitting in here instead of going out and walking around.
sentences.zh: 坐在这里而不是出去走动，又不会要了我的命。

sentences.en: I taped these calls with her permission.
sentences.zh: 在她的允许下，我录下了这些通话。

sentences.en: Dee was going on 88.
sentences.zh: Dee快88岁了。

sentences.en: I'd done the same thing with my other grandmother when she hit her late 80s.
sentences.zh: 我外祖母80多岁时我也做过同样的事。

sentences.en: It was just something to capture a little bit of their lives on tape while I still had them.
sentences.zh: 这只是为了在她们还在世时，录下一点她们的生活片段。

sentences.en: Dee had dementia, but it was pretty mild.
sentences.zh: Dee患有痴呆症，但症状很轻。

sentences.en: She'd forget small things, like where I lived, tell me stories she'd told me before.
sentences.zh: 她会忘记一些小事，比如我住在哪里，或者跟我讲她以前讲过的故事。

sentences.en: But she was still pretty with it.
sentences.zh: 但她头脑依然很清醒。

sentences.en: This was another reason for the frequent calls.
sentences.zh: 这也是频繁通话的另一个原因。

sentences.en: Isolation is really bad for anyone with dementia.
sentences.zh: 孤独对任何患有痴呆症的人来说都是非常糟糕的。

sentences.en: You've probably heard people say the brain is like a muscle.
sentences.zh: 你可能听人说过大脑就像一块肌肉。

sentences.en: You need to use it to maintain it.
sentences.zh: 你需要通过使用来维持它。

sentences.en: With dementia, this is especially true.
sentences.zh: 对于痴呆症患者来说，这一点尤为重要。

sentences.en: The more you use your mind, use words, the more those things stick with you.
sentences.zh: 你越是动脑、越是使用语言，这些东西就越能留在你的脑海里。

sentences.en: But when you're isolated, you stop practicing.
sentences.zh: 但当你与世隔绝时，你就停止了练习。

sentences.en: Your mind starts to slip away.
sentences.zh: 你的思维开始退化。

sentences.en: And once it goes, it usually doesn't come back.
sentences.zh: 一旦它消失了，通常就再也回不来了。

sentences.en: In those first calls, I didn't worry too much about that with Dee.
sentences.zh: 在最初的几次通话中，我并没有太担心迪的情况。

sentences.en: She'd worked as a therapist for decades and would still kind of do informal therapy on everyone, including me.
sentences.zh: 她做了几十年的治疗师，依然会习惯性地对每个人进行非正式的心理疏导，包括我。

sentences.en: Without my asking, she'd just start working out my options with me on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我还没开口，她就会在电话里帮我梳理各种选择。

sentences.en: Okay, what you do is you get a big piece of paper and you write down every one of them that you like to do.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你得找一张大纸，把你所有想做的事情都写下来。

sentences.en: What do I want?
sentences.zh: 我想要什么？

sentences.en: What do I not want?
sentences.zh: 我不想要什么？

sentences.en: Except he's standing in what might be a living room, though it might also be an antique shop.
sentences.zh: 但他站在的地方可能是一个客厅，尽管也可能是一家古董店。

sentences.en: It's full of framed pictures and little statues.
sentences.zh: 里面摆满了带框的照片和小雕像。

sentences.en: Often he's singing a classic, maybe a Sinatra song.
sentences.zh: 他经常唱经典歌曲，也许是弗兰克·辛纳屈的歌。

sentences.en: Still smiling, but now his smile seems kind of intense.

sentences.en: The whole project seemed obsessive and haunted, as if some club had shut down in the 1970s, but the performance had kept going.
sentences.zh: 整个项目看起来既痴迷又闹鬼，仿佛某个俱乐部在20世纪70年代倒闭了，但表演却一直持续着。

sentences.en: recognition he had always wanted.

sentences.en: The bit was that he was the world's oldest CBS page, an intern, basically, who'd been killing time in the bowels of the Ed Sullivan Theater for 38 years.

sentences.en: I hope he doesn't feel jealous.
sentences.zh: 我希望他不会感到嫉妒。

sentences.en: I hope he won't get mad.
sentences.zh: 我希望他不会生气。

sentences.en: I was, I don't know, seven or eight, feeling this mix of protectiveness towards him and fear, which, I don't know, is funny to think about today.
sentences.zh: 那时我大概七八岁，感受着这种对他的保护欲和恐惧的混合情绪，现在想起来觉得挺有意思的。

sentences.en: My mom, long dead.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈，早已去世。

sentences.en: My dad, getting up there, needing help with stuff that he never needed help with before.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸，年纪大了，需要帮助处理以前从未需要帮助的事情。

sentences.en: All that's left of that feeling is the protectiveness part.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉里剩下的只有保护欲的部分了。

sentences.en: The atoms of our bodies have replaced themselves so many times over that things between us have become very simple,
sentences.zh: 我们体内的原子已经更替了无数次，以至于我们之间的关系变得非常简单，

sentences.en: which, I suppose, is the best case for what can happen between parents and kids.
sentences.zh: 我想，这大概是父母和孩子之间能发生的最好的情况了。

sentences.en: But it doesn't always feel that way.
sentences.zh: 但感觉并不总是这样。
